duetflow/selector.py counts inferred candidate rows rather than distinct track IDs. With empty current, sampled_pool=['a1','a2'] and inferred_candidates=[Candidate('b1',2), Candidate('b1',2)], cold start selects the same inferred track twice and raises AssertionError instead of returning a duplicate-free RefreshPlan. The seeded tests generate unique inferred IDs only. Rule: I2 requires a unique track_id in every produced Duet, even when an input pool repeats a track.. Scope: All inferred-candidate availability, ranking, and admission paths in select, including cold start and steady state; random input generation and I2 assertions in tests/test_selector.py.. Verify: Pass duplicate qualified Candidate rows for the same track alongside enough distinct sampled tracks, both at cold start and with a nonempty Duet. Assert select returns normally, admits each track_id at most once, and preserves I1-I5..

duetflow/selector.py cannot grow a valid undersized Duet after cold start. With one current track on each side, target_size=4, both incumbents still eligible, one new sampled track and one new qualified inferred track, it only replaces the sampled incumbent and returns two tracks. Repeating Refreshes cannot reach four while the inferred incumbent stays above exit_threshold. Rule: ADR-0003 requires a Duet opened below target size to grow toward the target as qualified evidence accumulates, preserving the equal split and bounded turnover.. Scope: The nonempty-current selection branch for every below-target balanced Duet, including cases with attributed or unattributed Pins.. Verify: Start with one counted slot per side and target_size=4; offer one new eligible track per side while incumbents remain eligible. Assert a Refresh adds one on each side without evicting an incumbent, reaches four counted tracks, and stays within the per-side turnover limit..

duetflow/selector.py _evictable excludes every origin='pin' slot regardless of pinned_until. An inferred Pin whose term ended before now, whose score is below exit_threshold, and which has a qualified replacement remains in the Duet indefinitely; the same unconditional protection applies to Sampled Pins. Rule: ADR-0005 says an expired Pin reverts to ordinary eligibility; expiry alone does not evict it, but an otherwise eligible replacement may.. Scope: Pin treatment and eviction ranking on both sides of select, for expired and unexpired attributed Pins, while retaining the special count for unattributed Pins.. Verify: For each side, provide an expired Pin and a qualifying replacement and assert normal eviction eligibility; repeat with pinned_until after now and assert protection. Also assert an expired Pin stays when no replacement exists..

tests/test_selector.py assert_invariants equates inferred eviction and admission counts but never checks that the admitted replacement qualifies. A fabricated plan replacing b0 with Candidate('bad', 0.0) under entry_threshold=1.3 passes the helper unchanged, so the required tests do not actually assert I3's qualification condition. Rule: An I3 property test must establish that every inferred eviction is backed by a distinct eligible replacement, not only an equal number of admissions.. Scope: The common assert_invariants helper and its use by the seeded random, empty-pool, and single-candidate tests.. Verify: For each inferred eviction, assert a one-to-one admitted inferred ID with score at least entry_threshold, absent from vetoes, cooldowns and the old Duet. Show the assertion rejects a fabricated equal-count plan whose replacement scores below threshold, then run the seeded property tests..

duetflow/spotify.py:237-268 applies the generic 5xx retry policy to create_playlist POST, while duetflow/playlist.py:37-41 persists only the final returned id. If Spotify creates the first Duet but responds 500, the retry sends a second POST and can create a second Duet; I reproduced two create POSTs from one create_playlist call. A config write failure after a successful POST likewise leaves playlist_id unset and a second Refresh creates another Duet. Rule: A Refresh with duet.playlist_id unset must not create multiple Duets when creation has an ambiguous outcome or the returned id cannot yet be persisted.. Scope: The create-playlist POST retry path and the interval between a successful creation and durable duet.playlist_id persistence in ensure_playlist; this property applies across repeated Refresh attempts.. Verify: Use a stateful fake that records playlist creation before returning HTTP 500 on the first POST, and another that raises while persisting the returned id. Retry Refresh in each case and assert at most one Spotify playlist was created and the surviving id is the one persisted and reused..
